```yaml
name: CI Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
      with:
        python-version: "3.11"

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        uv pip install pytest ruff

    - name: Run pytest
      run: |
        pytest

    - name: Run ruff
      uses: astral-sh/ruff-action@v3
      with:
        args: --fix

    - name: Check path consistency
      run: |
        bash scripts/check-path-consistency.sh

    - name: Verify distribution
      run: |
        bash scripts/verify-distribution.sh

    - name: ShellCheck shell scripts
      uses: luizm/action-sh-checker@883217215b11c1fabbf00eb1a9a041f62d74c744
      with:
        sh_checker_exclude: ""
        sh_checker_comment: true
```
